summary: Syndax Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $250M aggregate principal amount of 2.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 in a private placement. Net proceeds of ~$243M will fund general corporate purposes including R&D and commercialization. This is a routine capital markets financing, not a special situation. No terms such as conversion price or premium are disclosed. The notes and underlying shares are unregistered, relying on Section 4(a)(2) exemption. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural special-situation features are mentioned. This filing is a standard convertible debt offering with no event-driven catalyst.
